blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Risa Hontiveros has vowed to work for the full implementation of laws protecting women and children as the country marked the start of its annual 18-Day Campaign to End Violence Against Women (VAW). Hontiveros, chairperson of the Senate committee on women and children, on Wednesday said that she would exercise the Senate’s oversight power to ensure that perpetrators are held accountable. “Titiyakin kong hindi lang nakasulat sa papel ang batas na ito. (I will make sure this law is not just written on paper.) We will exercise our oversight function to the fullest, so that every abuser and […]...
